- Tue 2027-05-18: 7:30–10:30 PDT (evening IST)
- Wed 2027-05-19: 8:00–11:00 PDT
- Thu 2027-05-20: 6:00–9:00 PDT

Two quick notes: Rahul has previous infra work for a large generative AI startup (quantization pipelines + KV cache layers) and is authorized to work remotely for US companies (contract + C2C conversation possible). Expected comp band: open to discussion — prefers competitive offer in line with senior IC (happy to share ranges after first loop).

Would you like me to coordinate an initial tech screen (30–45m)? I can send confirmed windows and calendar invites once you pick a slot.

Best,

Subject: Debrief: Rahul Mehta — first loop (Wed 5/19)
Attachments: scorecard-rahul-m.pdf, calendar-invite-Rahul-Mehta.ics

Folks — quick debrief from yesterday’s loop. Short summary + recommended next step: move Rahul to final manager round (Marissa to book).

Candidate summary (45m loop):
- Great systems instincts; clear ownership examples around cache eviction and multi-tenant KV layers.
- Strong on incident response and postmortems (gave a concrete example of a 6-hour outage resolution and blameless postmortem).
- Hands-on with k8s operator patterns and had a cogent plan for handling long tail IO latency in GPU-backed inference services.

Scores (out of 5):
- Systems design: 4
- Debugging/operational rigor: 5
- Cultural/communication: 4
- Overall fit for senior infra IC: 4 (recommend hire / senior IC)

Notes: Laura found the design tradeoffs reasonable though wanted a bit more depth on cache invalidation in geo-distributed setups (we can probe on that in the next round). Compensation target aligns with the band; he’s flexible on start date (2–4 weeks preferred).

Next steps:
1) Marissa — please schedule a 60m final round with the Engineering Director + one PM (we recommend 6/1–6/7 windows).
2) Recruiting (Vikram) — please prepare comp brief and written confirmation of org references.
3) I’ve attached the completed scorecard (scorecard-rahul-m.pdf) — please add any additional notes.

Thanks all — solid candidate.

—Sean
Principal, Infrastructure
Redwood Inference
